### Bible Pathway - Feb. 15, 2010
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-feb-15-2010-11626209.html
Passage: Numbers 7:2-5
Points:
- Tribal leaders could not perform priestly duties, but supported tabernacle ministry by donating wagons and oxen.
- Even though the leaders brought identical offerings, Scripture individually records each leader's gift, showing God remembers every act of service.
- Gifts were distributed to the Levite clans according to need, giving more transport resources to those carrying heavier loads.
- The Kohathites received no wagons because the holy objects had to be carried reverently upon their shoulders.
- Sacrificial giving to the Lord's work deepens a believer's desire to give and points to Christ's complete provision.
